name: M.O.B Signal
tagline: Dark-mode web design system for engineering consoles. 0px border-radius, 4px grid rhythm, and green signal accent.
description: A dark-only web design system for engineering interfaces. Square geometry, a 4px spacing scale and dense tables use one green accent for actions, selection, focus and healthy status. Information uses blue; warning and failure use distinct semantic roles. Space Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono are bundled locally with English and Vietnamese glyph coverage. Token values are defined in tokens.measured.json; CSS and compatibility exports are generated by the project build. Accessibility requirements are component-specific and supported by measured contrast, keyboard behavior and responsive tests.

seed.fontFamily: Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
seed.fontFamilyCode: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace

logo.notes: Use the supplied M.O.B artwork in logos/mob-logo/. The product name remains M.O.B Signal; the supplied outlined wordmark reads M.O.B and must not be retyped or extended. Use vectors/mob-lockup-dark.svg on dark surfaces, vectors/mob-lockup-light.svg on light surfaces, mono-black or mono-white for single-colour reproduction, and vectors/mob-symbol.svg for compact product navigation. Preserve natural aspect ratios and the supplied flat geometry. Clear space is 40 source units, scaled with the artwork (the pillar width on the 256-unit symbol grid). Minimum widths: symbol 16px, horizontal lockup 96px, stacked lockup 64px; print symbol 6mm and horizontal lockup 25mm. Source SVG geometry and outlined letters supersede the earlier square placeholder and font-based logo recipe. No glow, gradients, distortion or recolouring. Supplied pure-white mono assets are permitted logo-only exceptions to UI colour tokens. Original PNG files are preserved as supplied. Corrected full-frame PNGs are generated in logos/exports/ with geometry recorded in its manifest. Platform icon backing-plate rounding is permitted; UI controls remain square. Full inventory: logos/manifest.json. See BRAND.md section 17.

colors.name: Background
colors.usage: Full-page canvas. Matte neutral charcoal, deliberately not pure black so long sessions stay comfortable; inputs sit on this same value.

colors.name: Surface
colors.usage: Card bodies, primary navigation bar, data-table container. One step above canvas, never lighter.

colors.name: Foreground
colors.usage: Headings, body copy, primary figures. 16.91:1 on background and 16.00:1 on surface (AAA). It is never ink on an accent fill: #ededed on #00cc5c measures 1.83:1 and fails at any size, so #000000 is the only label colour on an accent fill.

colors.name: Muted
colors.usage: Disabled text, decoration, or large text only: at least 24 CSS px regular or 18.667 CSS px bold, with measured contrast of at least 3:1. Use text-secondary for small copy and placeholders.

colors.name: Border
colors.usage: Decorative separators. Essential control boundaries use control-border (#737373), not this low-contrast rule.

colors.name: Accent
colors.usage: Primary action, selection, focus and Operational status. Use text-on-primary on filled controls. Do not use large background washes or glow.

colors.name: System Info Blue
colors.usage: System information, links and ordinary chart series. This semantic role is independent of the primary action color.

voice.tone: Use sentence case for buttons, labels, table headers and navigation. Preserve the registered brand spelling M.O.B Signal exactly. Write actions as verb-first imperatives ("Deploy new service", "Save changes", "View audit log"), never ALL CAPS and never noun-only labels. Short, factual, no marketing superlatives; state the number instead of praising it.
messagingPillars: One accent, used with intent - one green #00cc5c marks the action, the selection, the focus and the healthy state, and nothing else gets it. What separates an action from a state is the word, the shape and the icon, not a second shade of green.
Square architecture - strict 0px radius and 1px rules communicate precision; rounding anything reintroduces the generic SaaS look.
Density with breathing room - high-information tables and panels on a 4px grid, with contrast and focus states doing the work that shadows usually take.
Accessibility is the spec, not the pass - AAA on primary text and on accent fills, visible keyboard focus on every interactive element.

use: Deploy, Provision, Rollback, Audit log, Latency, Region, Quota, Commit, Hash
Operational, Degraded, Failed, Pending (status words, sentence case)
tabular-nums for anything numeric that can change while you watch it
avoid: ALL CAPS labels and button text
glow, neon sign, blurred gradient blob, colorful ambient background
superlatives without a measurement (blazing, seamless, cutting-edge)
rounded pills, soft cards, colored shadows

imagery.style: No photography and no illustration. Visual interest comes from typography, 1px structure and status color, not from imagery. Icons are the exception and the only exception: inline SVG geometry from assets/icons/, drawn in the same square language, never a decorative scene, mascot or emoji.
subjects: code and commit hashes in mono
imagery.treatment: Any screenshot or product capture keeps the dark canvas and square framing; crop to the UI, no device mockup, no drop shadow, no colored overlay.
avoid: Neon glow, bloom or light-trail effects on text or edges
Radial-gradient blobs and blurred colored circles behind content
Generated placeholder art in place of real product screenshots

postureRules: UI controls use 0px radius. Supplied platform app-icon backing plates are an artwork exception; never round or redraw the brand mark.
Spacing comes from the 4px scale only - 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48. Card padding 24px, button padding 8px 16px, input padding 4px 12px, table cell 12px 16px.
Component kit must cover: Button (primary, secondary, ghost, danger, disabled), Card, Form (label, input, hint, focus, error), Navigation, Data Table, Badge, Kbd, and the keyboard focus ring.
Control height is 32px, derived from the source arithmetic 8px + 14px line + 8px + 2px border; base font size is 16px, small/label text is 14px, badge and kbd text is 12px.
Elevation uses black only: sm 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), md 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), lg 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6). Modals and popovers sit on surface-elevated #202020 plus lg.
Keyboard focus is mandatory and identical everywhere: box-shadow 0 0 0 2px #0a0a0a, 0 0 0 4px #00cc5c. Inputs additionally set border-color to #00cc5c with no layout shift.
Hover states step one surface level up (background -> #181818, #181818 -> #222222) and one border level up (#262626 -> #383838); they never change text color to a lighter gray.
High-density layout: table rows and panels stay tight, body lines capped under 80 characters, numeric columns right-aligned with tabular-nums, row hover at rgba(255,255,255,0.02).
Motion is a single 0.12s ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)) on background-color, border-color and color only. No scale, no parallax, no entrance choreography.

Dark only: no light theme is published. colors_and_type.css re-asserts color-scheme dark under prefers-color-scheme light, and the light surfaces in brand.html and system/kit.html are engine viewer chrome, not a brand mode.

One owner per component: tokens in colors_and_type.css, control recipes in components.css, floating surfaces in overlays.css. A component appears in exactly one sheet, so loading two can never yield two recipes.

Canonical values live in tokens.measured.json. The project build emits CSS and compatibility exports; checks fail on value drift, missing loaded variables, remote runtime resources or known obsolete scaffold.

Icons are authored, not measured: a 24x24 grid, 1.5px stroke, butt caps, miter joins, orthogonal geometry plus exact 45 degrees, currentColor, three sizes (16/20/24). No emoji, no icon font, no filled variant of an outlined glyph, no accent-colored icon outside the selected and healthy states.

Status is word plus marker plus icon, never hue alone: Operational, Degraded and Failed take a 6px solid square, Pending and Paused an outline square, and selection is always a 2px leading edge rather than a dot. The selected-row tint at 1.16:1 cannot carry state on its own. Operational runs on the same green as the accent: two near-identical greens cannot be made discriminable at any lightness, so the word and the square are what separate a healthy service from a call to action.

Overlay motion is the one amendment to the motion rule: opacity-only fades at 0.12s in and 0.08s out (67 percent), no transform, no slide, no scale, no stagger. prefers-reduced-motion collapses them and nothing depends on an animation to convey state.
No indeterminate progress anywhere: no spinner, no skeleton shimmer, no count-up. Progress is a determinate bar, and where duration is unknown the copy says so.

Charts run on secondary blue plus the neutral ramp and cap at four series. The accent appears in a chart only as the selected series or a threshold crossing. Lines are 2px, markers are 4px squares, bars are square with a 4px minimum gap, and a series is labelled at its end rather than only in a legend.

Layout is specified, not improvised: 12 columns on a 24px gap, breakpoints 640/768/1024/1280/1536, container 1200px for app and 920px for prose, nav band 48px with matching content padding reserved, sidebar 240px, drawer 360px, modal 480/640/880px, and z-index only from the 1/10/40/50/100/110/120/130 ladder.

Normal text requires 4.5:1. Large text is at least 24 CSS px regular or 18.667 CSS px bold and requires 3:1. Use text-secondary for small metadata and placeholders, error-text with an error marker for messages, and control-border for essential control boundaries.

Fine-pointer controls have a minimum 24px target. Coarse-pointer controls grow to 44px without overlapping invisible hit areas. Evaluate target size under WCAG 2.5.8 and 2.5.5; do not claim full conformance from size alone.

Copy follows the recorded formulas: an empty state names the thing and the one action, a field error states the constraint, an action failure says what happened to the request, a destructive confirm names the object and the recovery window in numbers, and a status word never stands alone.

Numbers are formatted, not free-styled: commit hashes 7 characters in mono, tabular figures on anything that can change while you watch it, 24-hour timestamps with the zone stated once per view, relative time only beside an absolute one, and truncated values reachable in full in one action.

Every asset in the bundle declares its provenance. The three font faces are OFL 1.1 and their licence text ships in fonts/licenses/; the icon family and the authored recipes are labelled as authored work; the archive digest is recorded so a later run can tell whether the source moved.
